strategyShift: Story will be rewritten. 灰關 is provisional opening draft, not the core. Build durable macro skeleton first; do not over-invest in draft fortress politics or cast until rewrite direction is chosen.
diagnosis: The project has thick raw inspiration and thin formal canon. Writing, engine context, and setting-pack conversion all fail when formal blocks are missing or conflict.

architectureLayers.name: raw_archive
architectureLayers.role: Frozen author source text and historical drafts.
architectureLayers.rule: Never rewrite. Never auto-promote to canon.

architectureLayers.name: formal_canon
architectureLayers.role: Author-locked JSON decisions and system specs.
architectureLayers.rule: One block at a time. Conflicts resolve in favor of this layer.

architectureLayers.name: foundation_cards
architectureLayers.role: Scene-packet and query planning surfaces derived from formal canon.
architectureLayers.rule: No card without a formal source document.

architectureLayers.name: setting_pack
architectureLayers.rule: Only after fortress, cast, and first-volume systems are locked.

architectureLayers.name: runtime_sqlite
architectureLayers.rule: Only through validate-setting-pack / apply-setting-pack and resolve-turn.

completionMethod.name: one_gate_per_session
rules: Each session resolves exactly one world block.
Each block has one author question, one formal JSON output, one index update.
Do not start setting-pack apply until Phase C is complete.
Do not write scene prose before the block needed for that scene is locked.

phases.name: macro_world_skeleton
phases.goal: Establish durable five-domain world shape independent of opening draft.

phases.name: provisional_opening_stage
phases.goal: Give 灰關 a temporary macro placement only; enough to connect, not enough to overbuild.

phases.name: rewrite_direction
phases.goal: Choose what the rewritten first volume must make readers want to explore.

phases.name: protagonist_pair
phases.goal: Lock dual protagonist backgrounds and relationship before volume one.

phases.name: first_volume_supporting_cast
phases.goal: Lock supporting cast only after protagonist pair and exploration cadence are set.

phases.name: narrative_secrets_author_only
phases.goal: Author knows what readers do not yet know.

phases.name: systems_curated_pack
phases.goal: Promote only the systems needed for volumes one to three from raw 02-04 into formal JSON.

phases.name: engine_conversion
phases.goal: Convert locked formal canon into setting pack and pilot session.

worldBlocks.resolution: 中域東北邊陲·虛海外圍帶次級邊關；距青雲關乙級廊道約12-24日。

worldBlocks.resolvedAnswer: Reader attraction is curiosity and exploration, plus visible protagonist progress. Lethal wilderness and unsafe sky raise the cost of learning, but do not replace learning as the hook.

worldBlocks.note: Do not lock draft politics while opening fortress remains provisional.

worldBlocks.questionForAuthor: 蘇橋的正式版本：工匠線（08）還是情報販子線（07），或你要怎麼合併？

worldBlocks.resolution: Three long-term themes stay author background; volume one delivers through linear story, not named topic exposition.
2026 Taiwan 基隆八斗子大坪海岸, typhoon Bavi pressure, tide trap, hillside abandoned building retreat.
Ghost-story hook: Japanese northern thermal power legacy, rushed WWII withdrawal, and an unknown hidden deposit.
逆行門計畫：封存實驗、企图回到过去却打开别界、日方先遣队有进无出、战后封存至今。
Slow interior progression with 愛醬; suspense layers; crossing time ambiguous to characters.
陸塵行 first doubt: why has no one mentioned this ruin, and why is there no useful online record?
Sea-wind smell and sticky coastal skin-feel are wrong at the ruin though the sea is still nearby.
No local rumors; the facility never entered public history, so ordinary people could not know it.
Experiment remnants, layered dead with time/cause logic, grey glass bottles with WWII-soaked corpses, partial gold take; crossing happens only after all of these, then no return.
Protection/revenge framing corrected; 愛醬 learning uncapped with own story line; not 妖獸/靈寵.

worldBlocks.note: Superseded as volume-one entry by Taiwan opening arc. Revisit only for post-crossing timeline.
